thread:
marta_marketing: Quick heads-up — aiming to announce v0.9.1 on Thursday 13:00 PT. Need final changelog + docs links, canary window, and a short copy for the social post. Also planning a 30-min webinar next Tue to walk through perf wins and routing. @raj_eng can you confirm canary/toggle timeline? :rocket:

raj_eng: Can do a canary but need to coordinate GPU rollout. Recommend 12:00–14:00 PT Thurs for canary; full rollout at 16:00 PT. Will post canary config + signal criteria.

kevin_docs: I'll publish the docs PR by EOD Wed. Will share link here. Short changelog blurb ready, need product sign-off on wording.

sophia_product: Copy needs to call out 30–40% token cost reduction on embeddings and the new rollout controls for Dedicated. Jamal, can you confirm sales routing script for inbound leads?

jamal_sales: Yep — we'll route enterprise leads to the enterprise queue and tag them "release-0.9.1". Can webinar registrants be auto-tagged?

marta_marketing: Yes please — we'll pass a tracking param and UTM. Draft headline for the announcement: "Redwood Inference v0.9.1 — faster, cheaper embeddings; safer rollouts for Dedicated." Thoughts? :thinking_face:

raj_eng: Looks good. Small engineering ask: add a note about canary fallback to cpu-n1 for older customers. Pasting the canary snippet we plan to use:

```bash
# canary rollout config
route: canary
percent: 10
fallback: cpu-n1
metrics: latency_p95 < 120ms
```

kevin_docs: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1123 — includes changelog, example requests, and the platform callout. Linking the specific changelog section in the blog will be easy.

marta_marketing: Great — we'll link that in the blog, tweet thread, and the webinar follow-up. Webinar format: 20-min demo, 10-min Q&A, 5-min CTA to docs + sign-up. Who can moderate Q&A?

sophia_product: I can moderate. Also please add a short "what this means for platform teams" box in the blog + docs.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary start 2026-04-02T12:00:00Z, full rollout 2026-04-02T16:00:00Z — author: raj_eng.

jamal_sales: For lead routing, I'll wire an automation to post to #ae-inbound when a lead gets tagged. Also adding a Slack thread template to summarize lead context for AEs.

marta_marketing: Final checklist: blog draft, docs link, canary config + fallback note, social copy, webinar page + registration, AE routing automation. If all green, publish blog at 13:00 PT Thurs and start canary at 12:00 PT.

raj_eng: All green from eng side — will monitor telemetry and rollback if p95 > 120ms or error rate spikes.

marta_marketing: Thanks team :rocket: — I'll post final links and the social schedule here when everything's live.
